name: CREB binding lysine acetyltransferase

function.text: CREBBP encodes the CBP transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which modifies histones and other proteins to regulate gene expression.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (autosomal dominant); Menke-Hennekam syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Retinoblastoma; Follicular lymphoma; Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: CREBBP encodes the CBP transcriptional coactivator and acetyltransferase, which modifies histones and other proteins to regulate gene expression.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Rubinstein-Taybi syndrome (autosomal dominant); Menke-Hennekam syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREBBP have been reported in retinoblastoma, follicular lymphoma, and diffuse large b-cell lymphoma.
